given_when_then.given: The system identifies an active Store Partner Agreement
given_when_then.when: The Platform Operator initiates an amendment to the agreement terms
given_when_then.then: A notification is sent to the Store Partner alerting them of the changes to their active agreement terms.

given_when_then.given: The Platform Operator creates an amendment to an active Store Partner Agreement
given_when_then.when: The system processes the amendment request
given_when_then.then: A new version of the agreement is created with updated terms, the previous version is archived as historical data, and a notification is sent to the Store Partner.

success_criteria: A Store Partner receives a notification regarding changes to their active agreement terms after the Platform Operator initiates an amendment.
